sources.title: e-Paarvai cataract field study
quotes: In this prospective diagnostic study conducted between January and April 2022 at a large tertiary-care eye hospital in South India, two screeners were trained to use the app.
Patients aged >40 years and with a best-corrected visual acuity <20/40 were recruited for the study.
